author: @ref0522
text:
I have so much to say that I've kept in my mind since the last time we talked. Things that I haven't been able to say to you due to time constraint and my nervousness. 

I tell you this, YOU make such great songs. Truly! The day I was finally free enough from my college back in 2022, I checked on you again to see you releasing new mini (Grey Suit). I also checked out your 1st mini (Self Portrait 자화상). My first impression was "OMG! I'm really happy that he does rock like this... Because my comfort songs are mostly rock!"

And I thought you were gonna branch out to RnB or dance songs in your 3rd album. It turns out you released another rock album!! 점선면 is such a treat to my ears...

You always release something that's even better than your previous ones (that's already great!). You actually take the saying of "Tomorrow, I'll be the better version of myself," to your heart, don't you 🥺

You and your contents had been with me during my job hunting that was so tiring and made me quite hopeless.

Nowadays, your content is my stress release from my tiring work. Keep doing this, okay!! I hope both you and I can still have fun together for more decades to come 🥰

Again, thank you so much 🐰💕

text: I’m still upset with SM for the Euro tour cancellation. Exo are known for having the most amazing concerts, and yearly always having fanmeetings larger than other artists’ concerts. Even if the official statement said it’s the European promoter’s fault, SM bears the responsibility to work with reputable and reliable companies only. The venues were much smaller than Asian venues, no back up dancers, much smaller production than their usual events and they couldn’t stay on top of it?! How could they do this to Suho’s name? and how can they do this to loyal fans like me who were so excited for the first ever Euro tour? and cancelling not just 1 show but every single show just few days before the sched?! I’m sorry for being immature and petty, but I just get pissed off everytime new Su:Home content is posted. Especially since they didnt even do an official announcement and explanation on Exo sns
